# statuspage_user (Resource)

Manages a Statuspage organization user. Note: not available for organizations using Atlassian accounts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "statuspage_user" "example" {
  organization_id = "org123"
  email           = "newuser@example.com"
  password        = "securepassword123"
  first_name      = "John"
  last_name       = "Doe"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String)
- `organization_id` (String)
- `password` (String, Sensitive)

### Optional

- `first_name` (String)
- `last_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
